meaning:
παρα-λογίζομαι
[in LXX chiefly for רָמָה pi. ;]
1. to miscalculate.
2. to reason falsely, hence, to mislead: Col.2:4, Jas.1:22.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Now I say this that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.
But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.
